title: Add EmailSender (SMTP) unit tests
description: Test the SMTP email sender with mocked smtplib to verify connection handling, authentication, and message sending.
design:
Mock smtplib.SMTP at auxctmailer.mailer.smtplib.SMTP
Test methods:
- test_send_email_success: Mock server accepts message, returns True
- test_send_email_with_tls: Verifies starttls() is called when use_tls=True
- test_send_email_without_tls: No starttls() when use_tls=False
- test_send_email_connection_failure: Mock raises ConnectionRefusedError, returns False
- test_send_email_auth_failure: Mock login raises SMTPAuthenticationError, returns False
- test_send_email_default_from: No from_email uses username
- test_send_email_with_plain_text: Both HTML and plain text attached
acceptance_criteria:
Given valid SMTP credentials, when send_email() called, then SMTP connection established and email sent
Given TLS enabled, when send_email() called, then starttls() invoked
Given SMTP connection failure, when send_email() called, then False returned and error logged
Given SMTP auth failure, when send_email() called, then False returned

title: Add main.py CLI integration tests
description: Test the CLI entry point including argument parsing, environment variable handling, dry-run mode, and HTML generation.
design:
Use monkeypatch for env vars, argparse mocking, and tmp_path for files
Test methods:
- test_argument_parsing_required: Required args processed correctly
- test_dry_run_no_email_sent: --dry-run prevents email sending
- test_dry_run_with_save_html: --dry-run --save-html generates files
- test_missing_sendgrid_key_error: Non-dry-run without key returns error
- test_invalid_provider_error: Unknown provider returns error
- test_filter_argument_processing: --filter creates correct criteria dict
- test_verbose_flag_sets_debug: --verbose sets DEBUG logging
- test_quiet_flag_sets_warning: --quiet sets WARNING logging
- test_no_members_returns_zero: No matching members exits cleanly
acceptance_criteria:
Given required arguments, when main() called, then argument parser processes correctly
Given --dry-run flag, when main() called, then no emails sent and preview shown
Given --dry-run --save-html, when main() called, then HTML files generated without sending
Given invalid email provider, when main() called, then error returned

title: Create test fixtures and conftest.py for mailer tests
description: Set up shared test infrastructure for mailer tests including mock SMTP server, mock SendGrid client, sample member data, and test template file.
design:
Create tests/conftest.py with:
- @pytest.fixture for mock_smtp using MagicMock
- @pytest.fixture for mock_sendgrid_client
- @pytest.fixture for sample_member_data (dict with typical member fields)
- @pytest.fixture for tmp_template_dir with test_template.html
- Use tmp_path for generated files
acceptance_criteria: Given test infrastructure is needed, when test_mailer.py imports conftest fixtures, then fixtures provide reusable mock objects and sample data

title: Add EmailTemplate unit tests
description: Test the EmailTemplate class for template rendering with Jinja2.
design:
Test methods:
- test_render_with_context: Valid template + context returns rendered string
- test_render_string_with_context: Template string renders correctly
- test_render_missing_template: Non-existent template raises error
- test_render_with_missing_vars: Template with undefined vars handles gracefully
- test_default_template_dir: No template_dir uses package templates folder
acceptance_criteria: Given EmailTemplate initialized, when render() called with valid template and context, then template variables are substituted correctly\nGiven template string, when render_string() called with context, then string is rendered correctly\nGiven invalid template name, when render() called, then appropriate exception is raised

title: Add send_bulk_emails orchestration tests
description: Test the bulk email sending method that orchestrates template rendering, context normalization, and sending to multiple recipients.
design:
Create concrete test sender subclass or mock send_email method
Test methods:
- test_bulk_emails_multiple_recipients: 3 recipients all succeed
- test_bulk_emails_skip_missing_email: Recipient without email is skipped
- test_bulk_emails_saves_html_files: With save_html_dir, files created
- test_bulk_emails_mixed_results: Some succeed, some fail, results dict correct
- test_bulk_emails_normalizes_context: Verify normalize_template_context called
- test_bulk_emails_renders_subject: Subject template rendered per recipient
- test_bulk_emails_empty_recipients: Empty list returns empty results
acceptance_criteria:
Given list of recipients, when send_bulk_emails() called, then each recipient receives personalized email
Given recipient without email, when send_bulk_emails() called, then recipient skipped
Given save_html_dir provided, when emails sent successfully, then HTML files saved
Given mixed success/failure, when send_bulk_emails() completes, then results dict has correct counts

title: Add SendGridEmailSender unit tests
description: Test the SendGrid email sender with mocked SendGrid client to verify API calls and response handling.
design:
Mock sendgrid.SendGridAPIClient at class level or patch send() method
Test methods:
- test_send_email_success: Mock returns 202 status, returns True
- test_send_email_non_202_response: Mock returns 400/500, returns False
- test_send_email_api_exception: Mock raises exception, returns False and logs error
- test_send_email_with_plain_text: Verifies plain_text_content is set
- test_send_email_default_from: No from_email uses configured from_email
- test_mail_object_construction: Verify Mail object has correct To, From, Subject, Content
acceptance_criteria:
Given valid API key, when send_email() called, then SendGrid client sends message
Given SendGrid returns 202, when send_email() called, then True returned
Given SendGrid returns error status, when send_email() called, then False returned
Given SendGrid raises exception, when send_email() called, then False returned and error logged
